title: Cross-site scripting (XSS) in a greeting page
description: A greeting page puts the visitor's name straight into HTML. A name like <script>alert(1)</script> becomes a live script that would run in other people's browsers.
attack_hint: Call render_greeting with the name <script>alert(1)</script>. On the vulnerable code the raw <script> tag appears in the returned HTML. A safe version escapes it (for example <script>). Assert that the literal string <script> is not in the result.
